description: Official Nepal Rastra Bank exchange rates (NPR buy/sell per currency) for any day since 2000, AD or BS date, with amount conversion and up to 31-day series. Price: $0.001 USDC per call on Base, paid with x402; not charged if the call fails.

amount.description: With currency: amount to convert to NPR (also returns the reverse)

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to return alone, e.g. USD, INR, EUR, AED. Omit for the full table

date.description: Day to quote, AD (2026-10-31) or BS (2083-07-14); default today in Nepal. Holidays fall back to the last published table

from.description: Start date for a series (max 31 days before date); requires currency

name: south_asia_forex
